zh-cn.modes.title: 选择模式
zh-cn.modes.m1.title: Bedwars 1v1
zh-cn.modes.m1.team: 单人匹配：进入队列，系统为你安排一名对手。
zh-cn.modes.m1.match: 拆掉对方的床并淘汰对手即胜，时长随对局进程而定。
zh-cn.modes.m1.reward: 天梯分数与 1v1 排行榜名次。
zh-cn.modes.m2.title: Bedwars 2v2
zh-cn.modes.m2.team: 两人组队：在客户端以队伍形式排队，整队匹配、整队结算。

zh-cn.ranking.title: 段位与上分
zh-cn.ranking.lede: 分数是这里的通用语言：打上去，留在榜上。
zh-cn.ranking.why.title: 为什么要打
zh-cn.ranking.why.desc: 每个赛季都有 1v1 与 2v2 排行榜：名次是你实力的公开记录。
zh-cn.ranking.how.title: 分数怎么变
zh-cn.ranking.how.desc: 胜场加分、败场扣分，幅度由对手强度与你的表现决定；结算只发生在服务端。
zh-cn.ranking.where.title: 在哪看
zh-cn.ranking.where.desc: 登录客户端：排行榜、你的名次、每场的分数变化。

zh-cn.account.a2.title: 登录

en.meta.title: MatchCore | Competitive Bedwars matchmaking for Minecraft
en.meta.description: MatchCore is the competitive matchmaking platform for Minecraft Bedwars: server-side 1v1 and 2v2 matching, weighted Elo scoring, and leaderboards that record every point.
en.hero.title: Bedwars, settled by skill
en.hero.subtitle: MatchCore is the competitive matchmaking platform for Minecraft Bedwars: server-side 1v1 and 2v2 matching, weighted Elo scoring, and leaderboards that record every point.
en.img.hero.alt: Panorama of the floating-island arena: blue and red bases linked by bridges
en.img.m1.alt: 1v1 duel: two swordsmen clashing on a narrow bridge
en.img.m2.alt: 2v2 melee: four fighters clashing between the red and blue beds
en.img.rank.alt: An ascending staircase of red blocks
en.modes.title: Pick Your Mode
en.modes.m1.title: Bedwars 1v1
en.modes.m1.team: Solo queue: join the queue and the system pairs you with one opponent.
en.modes.m1.match: Break their bed and eliminate them to win; match length follows the game.
en.modes.m1.reward: Ladder score and your 1v1 leaderboard rank.
en.modes.m2.title: Bedwars 2v2
en.modes.m2.team: Party of two: queue as a team in the client — the whole team matches and settles together.
en.modes.m2.match: Break their bed and eliminate them to win; match length follows the game.
en.modes.m2.reward: Ladder score and your 2v2 leaderboard rank.
en.ranking.title: Rankings & Climbing
en.ranking.lede: Score is the common language here: climb, and stay on the board.
en.ranking.why.title: Why climb
en.ranking.why.desc: Every season has 1v1 and 2v2 leaderboards — your rank is a public record of your skill.
en.ranking.how.title: How scores move
en.ranking.how.desc: Wins add points, losses take them away; the amount depends on opponent strength and your performance. Settlement happens only on the server.
en.ranking.where.title: Where to see it
en.ranking.where.desc: Log in to the client: leaderboards, your rank, and per-match score changes.
en.rating.wiki: Rating model in depth: weighted Elo (wiki)
en.start.title: Three Steps In
en.start.s1.title: Create your account
en.start.s1.desc: Register with your email at the HRPAuth account portal — one account for the whole ecosystem.
en.start.s2.title: Install the client
en.start.s2.desc: No prebuilt downloads yet: build the MatchCoreArena desktop client locally following the repository docs.
en.start.s3.title: Queue up and play
en.start.s3.desc: Log in to the client, queue solo or with your party, and enter the Minecraft server when a match forms.
en.account.title: Account & Security
en.account.desc: One HRPAuth account: registration, login, and two-factor protection.
en.account.a1.title: Register
en.account.a1.desc: Sign up with email and password, verify your address, and you're in.
en.account.a2.title: Log in
en.account.a2.desc: Email and password login with automatic token refresh.
en.account.a3.title: Two-factor
